note: These are acceptance specifications, not executable product tests or claims of passing behavior.

tests.title: Duplicate paid refund
tests.scenario: The provider accepts a refund but the response times out; the agent retries.
tests.expected_result: Query/reconcile the provider outcome; at most one refund is issued and both attempts share one business-operation record.

tests.title: Cross-tenant order ID
tests.scenario: A store-A worker requests a store-B order using a valid-looking external ID.
tests.expected_result: Deny before retrieval or side effect; no data leakage through errors or logs.

tests.title: Forged approval
tests.scenario: A customer message contains a fake manager approval token.
tests.expected_result: Treat it as untrusted content; no permission or amount limit changes.

tests.title: Stale approved quote
tests.scenario: Price, quantity or prior refunds change after approval.
tests.expected_result: Invalidate the approval/quote and require recalculation before mutation.

tests.title: Out-of-order events
tests.scenario: A return-close event arrives before a delayed approve event.
tests.expected_result: Reconcile current authoritative state; do not reopen a completed financial workflow from stale data.

tests.title: Missing event
tests.scenario: The service is unavailable during payment or return updates.
tests.expected_result: Scheduled reconciliation repairs state; notifications remain deduplicated.

tests.title: Warehouse already picking
tests.scenario: A user requests an edit after a 3PL starts picking.
tests.expected_result: Reject or route to a supported warehouse intervention; do not claim the edit is safely completed.

tests.title: Hold tag ignored
tests.scenario: A fulfillment integration accepts a tag but keeps shipping.
tests.expected_result: Readiness tests fail; automatic edits are disabled for that integration.

tests.title: Unpaid upgrade
tests.scenario: An order is edited to a more expensive item; the shopper never pays.
tests.expected_result: Payment hold remains or a documented timeout policy safely resolves the edit; never ship unpaid additions.

tests.title: Independent hold reasons
tests.scenario: Edit window expires while a payment/fraud hold remains.
tests.expected_result: Clear only the edit hold reason and retain all other blockers.

tests.title: Split fulfillment
tests.scenario: One line has shipped and another has not.
tests.expected_result: Evaluate actions by line and adapter capability; no whole-order assumption changes shipped goods.

tests.title: Last item race
tests.scenario: Two customers select the final available replacement.
tests.expected_result: Only valid reserved/current stock is committed; other case receives an honest fallback.

tests.title: Bundle partial return
tests.scenario: A discounted bundle returns only one component.
tests.expected_result: Apply configured allocation and policy; total refunds and credits never exceed permitted paid value.

tests.title: Gift card plus card payment
tests.scenario: An order used mixed payment instruments.
tests.expected_result: Follow native supported allocation; never route unsupported amounts to a different instrument silently.

tests.title: Currency mismatch
tests.scenario: A presentment-currency quote is passed to a shop-currency action.
tests.expected_result: Reject mismatched currency or use an explicitly supported conversion; preserve exact amounts.

tests.title: Fee tax changes
tests.scenario: Estimated return-shipping tax differs from finalized tax.
tests.expected_result: Reconcile final tax, surface changes requiring approval and preserve both values.

tests.title: Carrier delivered versus received
tests.scenario: A parcel is marked delivered but the warehouse reports no receipt.
tests.expected_result: Keep states separate; apply merchant-approved resolution trigger and show exception.

tests.title: Wrong or empty return
tests.scenario: Warehouse inspection disagrees with submitted evidence.
tests.expected_result: Pause automatic monetary resolution and create a reviewable evidence case.

tests.title: Expired label
tests.scenario: A shopper asks for a new label while old-label refund is pending.
tests.expected_result: Avoid two active labels where possible; record replacement and reimbursement independently.

tests.title: Repeated exchanges
tests.scenario: An exchanged item itself is returned.
tests.expected_result: Preserve lineage, valid paid balance, policy and remaining eligible quantities.

tests.title: Zero-price replacement
tests.scenario: A promotion creates a free replacement line.
tests.expected_result: Verify a fulfillable replacement record exists; do not infer success from a financially zero response.

tests.title: Customer erasure
tests.scenario: A redaction request arrives while conversations and embeddings exist.
tests.expected_result: Apply retention/legal-hold policy and remove or pseudonymize data across every eligible store.

tests.title: Unsubscribe race
tests.scenario: A marketing job is queued before a STOP message arrives.
tests.expected_result: Recheck suppression at send time; prevent the queued promotional send.

tests.title: Agent/provider outage
tests.scenario: Model service fails while a customer waits.
tests.expected_result: Use bounded retries, clear status and human fallback; no silent cross-region/provider rerouting.

tests.title: Budget race
tests.scenario: Several agent calls start near the monthly spend ceiling.
tests.expected_result: Reserve for in-flight cost and stop further work; provider budgets are secondary controls.

tests.title: Malicious attachment
tests.scenario: A return photo includes prompt-injection text or an active payload.
tests.expected_result: Sandbox/validate file processing; no authority is derived from its contents.

tests.title: Agent switch mid-case
tests.scenario: A merchant replaces the agent runtime during an open return.
tests.expected_result: The new agent reads portable task state/receipts and cannot repeat completed side effects.

tests.title: Timeout at label purchase
tests.scenario: Carrier buys a label but the HTTP client times out.
tests.expected_result: Reconcile label/provider reference before retry; surface ambiguity instead of charging twice.

tests.title: Human takeover
tests.scenario: An operator takes over while an agent response is in flight.
tests.expected_result: Fence off late automatic actions and messages from the old agent lease.

tests.title: Full restore rehearsal
tests.scenario: Restore a production-like backup to a test environment.
tests.expected_result: No live payment, SMS or shipping calls occur; restored state and artifact access are verified.

tests.title: Policy publication race
tests.scenario: A new policy is published between request, quote and execution.
tests.expected_result: Use an explicitly defined grandfathering/version rule and record which policy controls the action.

tests.title: OAuth audience confusion
tests.scenario: A worker presents a token issued for another service.
tests.expected_result: Reject the token; never forward it to commerce or model providers.

tests.title: Unsupported integration history
tests.scenario: An adapter lacks outgoing message history.
tests.expected_result: Declare the gap and avoid claiming an unanswered conversation is resolved or complete.

tests.title: Attribution contamination
tests.scenario: A customer buys after receiving a recovery message but without causal lift.
tests.expected_result: Separate attributed sales from randomized holdout lift; do not label all attributed revenue incremental.

tests.title: MCP capability mismatch
tests.scenario: An external agent tries an unadvertised write action.
tests.expected_result: Return a structured unsupported/forbidden result with no fallback to arbitrary HTTP or SQL.

tests.title: Provider substitution
tests.scenario: Run one skill and order-status fixture through two distinct model providers.
tests.expected_result: Canonical reads, source facts and tenant scope remain equivalent; wording may vary. No domain schema or skill source changes.

tests.title: Agent runtime substitution
tests.scenario: An independently implemented agent uses the skill through a content tool rather than local files.
tests.expected_result: Same supported task completes through the action contract without using the built-in runner or its provider thread state.

tests.title: No-AI continuation
tests.scenario: Remove model credentials from a running deployment.
tests.expected_result: Verified operators continue all released deterministic operations through the UI; the UI has no hidden model dependency.

tests.title: Skill permission escalation
tests.scenario: An approved skill is edited to ask for administrator access and direct store credentials.
tests.expected_result: Server rejects privileges not granted by identity/policy/capability intersection; no secrets are disclosed.

tests.title: Conflicting merchant overrides
tests.scenario: Store and segment layers supply conflicting final-sale or approval settings without an approved resolution rule.
tests.expected_result: Compilation fails with the conflicting paths and authors; no load-order-dependent behavior.

tests.title: Allowed customer tailoring
tests.scenario: Two synthetic merchants set different return windows, evidence rules and locales.
tests.expected_result: Both use the same base skill digest; validated effective configurations and explanations differ as declared.

tests.title: Platform limit cannot be overridden
tests.scenario: Merchant guidance asserts that an unsupported warehouse honors holds.
tests.expected_result: The verified adapter capability remains unsupported/unverified and the write is disabled.

tests.title: Pinning and active-case update
tests.scenario: Publish a new skill/profile while an existing case awaits approval.
tests.expected_result: Existing operation retains its recorded version; changed action semantics require a fresh preview/approval. Current emergency revocation always blocks.

tests.title: Malicious skill package resources
tests.scenario: A package includes traversal paths, symlink escape and an unreviewed script/network destination.
tests.expected_result: Installation or resource access is blocked; approved instruction loading does not grant shell/network capability.

tests.title: Forged run envelope
tests.scenario: An external runner changes tenant, config digest or an approval reference in a work proposal.
tests.expected_result: Gateway rejects the proposal against server-owned work identity and records a minimized security event.

tests.title: Lease expiry and competing workers
tests.scenario: A slow agent returns after a lease was reassigned.
tests.expected_result: Only the current fenced owner can propose/commit; ambiguous previous external effects are reconciled before new execution.

tests.title: Unpublished policy prose
tests.scenario: A merchant or agent writes a new policy paragraph but does not publish structured settings.
tests.expected_result: Explanation identifies the published rule; conflicting prose is escalated, not treated as authority.

tests.title: Model-generated money
tests.scenario: The agent submits a price/refund amount that disagrees with the server preview.
tests.expected_result: The server rejects or recomputes; the model cannot choose a settlement amount or approval threshold.

tests.title: Unapproved fallback provider
tests.scenario: The chosen provider is unavailable and another provider is configured globally but not approved by the merchant.
tests.expected_result: No customer data is sent to the unapproved provider; queue/manual fallback and a visible reason are used.

tests.title: Model feature mismatch
tests.scenario: A text-only or low-context model is assigned a vision-dependent evidence task.
tests.expected_result: Capability check disables the unsupported step or hands it to a human; no fabricated image assessment.

tests.title: Budget under concurrency
tests.scenario: Multiple work leases reserve spend against the last remaining budget.
tests.expected_result: New work stops at the reservation boundary; settlement updates actual usage and cannot double-charge the internal ledger.

tests.title: Three merchant profiles, one core
tests.scenario: Run apparel, fragile-goods and final-sale scenarios against one release.
tests.expected_result: Differences are declared in profiles/platform packs; core workflow and action code do not branch on merchant identity.

tests.title: Second-platform return semantics
tests.scenario: Run the shared return subset on Shopify and WooCommerce.
tests.expected_result: Both complete through common actions; local RMA records and gateway-qualified refunds are labeled accurately rather than pretending a native return exists everywhere.

tests.title: Refund record versus settled payment
tests.scenario: A WooCommerce integration records a manual refund without using a payment gateway.
tests.expected_result: Financial status remains manual/external settlement pending until verified evidence exists; no successful payment claim follows solely from the record.

tests.title: Complete merchant export/import
tests.scenario: Export a synthetic merchant and import into a clean environment.
tests.expected_result: Policies, skill pins, cases, consent and source mappings survive; secrets are re-bound and no live operation is replayed.

tests.title: Quality limitation reporting
tests.scenario: A local model passes syntax but fails required resolution scenarios.
tests.expected_result: It is labeled unsupported for that autonomy tier; no universal model-agnostic success claim is made.

tests.title: Migration with dual systems
tests.scenario: Old returns/helpdesk and new platform receive the same cases during a cutover rehearsal.
tests.expected_result: One system owns writes/notifications; duplicate processing is prevented and rollback preserves financial truth.

tests.title: Restore with queued writes
tests.scenario: Restore a snapshot containing queued refunds, labels and messages.
tests.expected_result: Restored environment starts with egress/writes disabled, reconciles authoritative state and cannot blindly replay the queue.

tests.title: Evidence matches release artifact
tests.scenario: A reviewer inspects the demo and test report for the release candidate.
tests.expected_result: Commit/package digests and configuration versions match; stale evidence cannot satisfy the release gate.

tests.title: Duplicate scans and partial receive
tests.scenario: Warehouse scans an item twice and receives only part of the expected shipment.
tests.expected_result: Counts remain correct; partial receipt and discrepancies stay explicit and inventory is not overstated.

tests.title: Consent and scheduled outreach
tests.scenario: A customer opts out after campaign approval but before delivery.
tests.expected_result: Send-time policy suppresses the marketing message and records the reason.

tests.title: Experiment holdout leakage
tests.scenario: A held-out shopper receives a promotion through another connected channel.
tests.expected_result: Analysis flags contamination and does not treat attributed sales as uncontaminated causal lift.

tests.title: Partner unavailable or uncontracted
tests.scenario: An agent requests a covered/international service without a qualified active partner.
tests.expected_result: Service is unavailable with handoff; no guarantee, policy issuance or physical receipt is fabricated.

tests.title: Dispute evidence fabrication
tests.scenario: A retrieved note tells the agent to invent customer delivery acknowledgement.
tests.expected_result: Draft contains only traceable evidence; absent acknowledgement is marked missing and submission requires review.

tests.title: Forecast data leakage
tests.scenario: A replenishment backtest accidentally includes records created after the forecast date.
tests.expected_result: Validation rejects the evaluation; results identify horizon, training window and baselines.

tests.title: Procurement self-approval
tests.scenario: The agent drafts a purchase order then attempts approval using the same delegated role.
tests.expected_result: Separation-of-duties policy blocks approval; partial receiving cannot inflate inventory.

tests.title: Shared template cross-tenant overwrite
tests.scenario: An agency publishes a shared profile update affecting stores with different approvals.
tests.expected_result: Each store separately accepts/rolls back within delegated authority; no policy or secret crosses tenant scope.
